_comment: Curated reachability table for discover/generator sources (analysis/engine_coaching.md Plan 2 Layer A). Keyed by base card id (minions/trinkets DB ids) or 'hero:<Name>'. kind: 'discover' = a discover MENU, tier-limited and trustworthy -> the _hunt_check TIER gate passes when its cap reaches the piece, and it bypasses the POOL gate (a discover does not roll the shared pool). 'token' = a deterministic generator of a SPECIFIC card (also certain; bypasses POOL; carries 'grants'). 'random_generate' = pool-weighted randomness for a named card -> WEAK MENTION ONLY, never a gate (the design's asymmetry: RNG identity matters for specific hunts, not for fuel). tier_cap: int, or 'tier+1' / 'current' resolved against the live tavern tier. Every entry quotes the card's own text - the Butchering-fix pattern. Sources live when the card is on board, in hand, or held as a trinket; hero entries when the hero matches. Log ground truth 2026-09-15 game 4: a tier-6 Unbound Tempest materialized at tavern tier 5 from a 'get a random Elemental' source (tag BACON_SUBSET_ELEMENTALS + IS_BACON_POOL_MINION, TECH_LEVEL=6) - random generation is NOT player-tier-capped unless the text says so.

hero:Ambassador Faelin.name: Ambassador Faelin

hero:A. F. Kay.name: A. F. Kay
hero:A. F. Kay.text: Skip your first two turns, then Discover a minion from Tier 3 and Tier 4.

hero:Elise Starseeker.name: Elise Starseeker
hero:Elise Starseeker.text: Discover a minion from your Tier. Costs (1) more after each use.

hero:Infinite Toki.name: Infinite Toki
hero:Infinite Toki.text: Refresh the Tavern. Include two minions from a Tier higher than yours.
